# OyeRide

> Fast motor rides and reliable deliveries in Kasoa, Ghana. Book a ride or send a package in seconds.

OyeRide is a ride-hailing and delivery platform operating in Kasoa, Ghana. It connects passengers and senders with nearby motorcycle and bicycle riders through a mobile app and web platform.

## Services

- **Oye Motor Ride**: On-demand motorcycle taxi service for beating Kasoa traffic. Passengers book a rider, track them live on a map, and pay a transparent upfront fare starting from GHS 10.
- **Oye Motor Delivery**: Motorcycle-based package delivery for larger items or longer distances across Kasoa. Real-time tracking included.
- **Oye Bicycle Delivery**: Eco-friendly bicycle delivery for documents, food, and small parcels over short distances. The most affordable option.

## Platforms

- Android app (free download)
- Web app for passengers: https://oye-ride.web.app/
- Web app for drivers: https://oye-riders.web.app/
- Official website: https://oye-official.web.app/

## Key Features

- Real-time GPS tracking of driver from acceptance to destination
- Surge pricing based on demand, time of day, and location
- Live driver-to-pickup route shown on passenger map
- In-app push notifications at every ride stage
- 10% new user discount on first 2 completed rides
- In-app chat between passenger and driver
- Ride history and ratings
- Multi-stop bookings (up to 3 stops)

## Target Users

- Passengers in Kasoa needing fast, affordable transport
- Businesses and individuals sending packages across Kasoa
- Motorcycle and bicycle riders looking to earn income flexibly

## Company

- Founded in Ghana
- Operating in Kasoa
- Expanding to more Ghanaian cities
- Driver signup: https://oye-riders.web.app/signup

- Privacy Policy: https://oye-official.web.app/privacy.html
